text: 中国铁建公告，2026年前三季度营业收入6394.47亿元，同比下降12.21%；归母净利润93.48亿元，同比下降36.88%；扣非净利润87.12亿元，同比下降37.19%。第三季度单季营业收入2110.09亿元，同比下降11.79%；归母净利润6.58亿元，同比下降83.98%；扣非净利润6.35亿元，同比下降84.08%。利润下降主要因全国固定资产投资下降、房地产市场持续调整，工程承包业务和房地产业务利润下降。
text_en: China Railway Construction announced that in the first three quarters of 2026, operating revenue was 639.447 billion yuan, down 12.21% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders was 9.348 billion yuan, down 36.88% year on year; net profit after deducting non-recurring gains and losses was 8.712 billion yuan, down 37.19% year on year. In the third quarter alone, operating revenue was 211.009 billion yuan, down 11.79% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders was 658 million yuan, down 83.98% year on year; net profit after deducting non-recurring gains and losses was 635 million yuan, down 84.08% year on year. The decline in profit was mainly due to the drop in fixed asset investment nationwide and the continued adjustment of the real estate market, which led to lower profits in the engineering contracting business and the real estate business.
